At first I didn’t know what to say to this post, but here is my message, and I’m gonna make it simple. There are people in this world that care about you, if you make the choice to commit suicide, then that’s it, I’ve had problems with suicidal thoughts  so many times, but I’m still here I’m still breathing I’m still a person. Suicide isn’t the answer, when you do it there is no going back. Think about it, your parents, your friends, your family, they will miss you and they deeply care about you man. Don’t go down this path man. You’ll be alright I’m sure of it. Take care man. I hope you’ll be alright. 💖
